'''Gemstone Sack''' is a [[Sacks|Sack]] unlocked at {{Collection|Gemstone|1}}. It has 3 sizes, each size increasing the number of items it can hold. The amount of each item the sack can hold is determined by the tier's weight, with '''{{white|Rough}}''' being {{green|1}}, '''{{Green|Flawed}}''' being {{green|80}}, and '''{{blue|Fine}}''' being {{green|6,400}}. The Small Gemstone Sack can hold {{green|128,000}} weight, the Medium Gemstone Sack can hold {{green|512,000}} weight, and the Large Gemstone Sack can hold {{green|2,560,000}} weight.

== Trivia ==
* While both small and medium variants have a collection requirement to unlock the crafting recipe, the large variant doesn't.
* For a short time after the [[Changelog/2021/July 13|v0.12 Crystal Hollows Update]], '''{{Item|Extra Large Gemstone Sack|link=}}''' ({{Code|EXTRA_LARGE_GEMSTONE_SACK}}) was craftable with {{Item|Rough Ruby Gemstone|amount=42}}, {{Item|Enchanted String|amount=16}} and {{Item|Enchanted Leather|amount=4}}. It did not function as a Sack, and was placeable. Its recipe was removed soon after.
*Ever since a patch made it so flawless and perfect gemstones could not be stacked, these variants are not able to be placed in gemstone sacks.
